subject: The 3-minute secret most couples miss
preview_text: A tiny habit that turns date planning into a no-brainer. Open this before your partner does.
body_paragraphs: I have a confession. For weeks after downloading this app, I was using it wrong. I'd open it, scroll around, get overwhelmed by all the date ideas, close it, and then forget about it until the weekend. Sound familiar? Here's the thing: the couples who actually transform their relationship don't do that. They've discovered a 3-minute routine that makes this app 10x more effective.

It's called the 'micro-habit loop.' Every morning, while you're sipping your coffee or brushing your teeth, you spend exactly three minutes in the app. One minute to check your shared wishlist. One minute to swipe through a few date ideas. One minute to send a surprise to your partner. That's it. No pressure, no planning marathons. Just a tiny daily spark that builds into a wildfire of connection.

Here's what happens after three days of this: your partner gets a notification that you're thinking about them. After a week, you've got a wishlist full of future fun. After a month, you've never had a boring date again. The app's date history tracking makes sure of that. It's not about the big gestures. It's about the daily reminder that you care enough to show up.

So here's your one move: open the app right now and spend three minutes on your shared wishlist. Add one crazy idea and one simple one. That's it. P.S. The couples who do this for a week report feeling 40% more connected. Your move.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and start your 3-minute routine
